member.name: T:Tracto.Desktop.Ipc.SupervisorPipeServer
member.summary: Named-pipe server endpoint owned exclusively by the Supervisor process. Accepts exactly one Executor client connection; access is restricted to the current Windows user SID via OS-enforced ACL.
member.remarks: This class intentionally contains no GUI-input APIs (SendInput, mouse_event, keybd_event, SetForegroundWindow, etc.). The Supervisor cannot inject desktop events by design — that boundary is enforced structurally, not by policy alone.
